occurrences.quote: From passage [1]: Tom Kitt won the Tony Award and 2008 Outer Critics Circle Award for "Next to Normal". However, passage [1] states he won the "2010 Pulitzer Prize" (not 2007 Tony), and it mentions he "won the Tony Award and 2008 Outer Critics Circle Award" but doesn't specify the year of the Tony Award.
From passage [2]: "Next to Normal" won the "2009 Tony Awards for Best Original Score" - so the Tony Award was in 2009, not 2007.

[3] «Paulo Szot | Paulo Szot ( ; born July 7, 1969 ) is a Brazilian operatic baritone singer and actor.  He made his opera debut in 1997 and his international career has included performances with the Metropolitan Opera.  In 2008, he made his Broadway debut as Emile De Becque in a revival of "South Pacific", and for his performance in this musical he won the Tony Award for Best Performance by a Leading Actor in a Musical, the Drama Desk Award, the Outer Critics Circle Award, the Theatre World Award.

[4] «Brian Flemming | Brian Flemming is an American film director, playwright and activist.  His films include "Hang Your Dog in the Wind", "Nothing So Strange", and "The God Who Wasn't There".  His musicals include "", which won the LA Weekly Theater Award, Lucille Lortel Award, and Outer Critics Circle Award.

[5] «Heidi Ettinger | Heidi Ettinger (married name "Landesman") is an American theatre producer and set designer.  She studied at Occidental College and the Yale School of Drama.  She was the first woman to win a Tony Award for set design, which she won for the musical "Big River".

[6] «Lynn Ahrens | Lynn Ahrens (born October 1, 1948) is an American writer and lyricist for the musical theatre, television and film.  She has collaborated with Stephen Flaherty for many years.  She won the Tony Award, Drama Desk Award, and Outer Critics Circle Award for the Broadway musical "Ragtime".

[7] «Victoria Clark | Victoria Clark (born October 10, 1959) is an American musical theatre singer and actress.  Clark has performed in numerous Broadway musicals and in other theatre, film and television works.  Her soprano voice can also be heard on innumerable cast albums and several animated films.  In 2008, she released her first solo album titled "Fifteen Seconds of Grace".  In 2005, she won a Tony Award for Best Leading Actress in a Musical for her role in "The Light in the Piazza".
Did Janet Krupin perform as a swing in "Next to Normal"? When did Tom Kitt win the Tony Award for "Next to Normal"?

Tom Kitt (musician) | Thomas Robert "Tom" Kitt (born February 28, 1974) is an American composer, conductor, orchestrator and musician.  For his score for the musical "Next to Normal", he shared the 2010 Pulitzer Prize for Drama with Brian Yorkey.  He also won the Tony Award and 2008 Outer Critics Circle Award

Brian Yorkey | Brian Yorkey is an American playwright, lyricist, librettist, screenwriter, and theatre director known best for writing the musical "Next to Normal" with composer Tom Kitt as well as being the co-showrunner on 13 Reasons Why.  The work won the 2010 Pulitzer Prize for Drama and the 2009 Tony Awards for Best Original Score

Next to Normal | Next to Normal (stylized as next to normal) is a 2008 American rock musical with book and lyrics by Brian Yorkey and music by Tom Kitt.  The story centers around a mother who struggles with worsening bipolar disorder
